notes: Matches the founder's own honest finding closely. Tried again for ClinikEHR (the founder's #1 candidate, already confirmed real content when researching Pharmacy) — found a page element literally reading 'RSS' on their blog homepage, strong evidence a feed exists, but still could not determine the exact feed URL with the same confidence as the WordPress /feed/ pattern used elsewhere, so left out rather than guess a URL with zero direct evidence. On channels: multiple real Nigerian dental clinics have YouTube presences (SS Dental Clinic, Smiledoctor/Luxe Dental, Schubbs Dental, Breeze Smile) but every one markets the clinic to patients — none teaches dentists how to run the business — so none were counted, matching the same discipline applied to real-estate agency channels and PR agency channels in earlier categories. Books: no dentistry-specific title exists separately from Medicine's already-exhausted, paid-only list.
